exposure: gestational age based on the last menstrual period
gestational age based on the first ultrasound
outcome: Relationship between placental pathologies and various factors
cohort: Pregnant women who underwent pregnancy termination and had their placentas examined at a tertiary hospital between 2019-2020
finding: The study found that placental pathologies were relatively uncommon (7.8%) and that there was no significant relationship between placental pathologies and intra-uterine fetal death, preeclampsia, maternal age, or gestational age.
mod_finding: The study on placental pathologies found that 79.4% of deliveries were cesarean sections, while 20.6% were vaginal deliveries.
gest_age: Mentioned as an exposure variable but not specified
